versions.content: Semantics of DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula . nrc- Value If a diagnostic functionality cannot be executed because an environmental condition fails, i.e. the formula is evaluated to false, then the diagnostic stack shall send an optional negative response code (NRC) back to the client (if it is present). If no value for NRC is defined then a pre-defined NRC value as defined in the SWS Dcm [10] will be sent back. The value of the NRC is directly related to the specific DiagnosticEnvConditionFormula and is therefore formalized in the attribute Di- agnosticEnvConditionFormula . nrcValue .
